notes:
Scope and method: Lumen Health Partners, fiscal 2026, systems in scope NetSuite and ClaimsLens. Five controls in the documents are relevant to AC-PROV, AC-UAR and CM-CHG: C1 automated provisioning (narrative L11), C2 elevated NetSuite role requests (narrative L13), C3 NetSuite access review (narrative L17), C4 NetSuite change management (narrative L21) and C5 ClaimsLens change management (narrative L25). Every criterion listed is quoted from narrative or policy text. Where a criterion is absent, it is recorded below as a finding and no value is supplied.

Missing-criterion findings:
(a) PROV-F rule approval: no criterion for C1 (narrative L11).
(b) PROV-D grant matches request: no criterion for C2. Narrative L13 states only that the Jira key is attached to the assignment.
(c) PROV-E conflict check: none. Narrative L13 says there is no formal conflict list and the Finance Systems Manager uses judgement.
(d) PROV-G temporary grants: temporary or time-boxed grants are not described for either system.
(e) UAR-D completion timeframe: none. 'Twice a year' (narrative L17) and 'at least twice a year' (policy L7) are frequencies, not completion timeframes.
(f) UAR-F lookback: none. Narrative L17 says no usage assessment has been performed.
(g) CHG-E emergency timeframe: none for NetSuite (narrative L21 says there is no written procedure) or for ClaimsLens.
(h) ClaimsLens testing criterion (CHG-B): absent from narrative L25.

Conflicts between narrative and policy, for a qualified human to resolve:
- Approver: Finance Systems Manager (narrative L13) versus employee's manager or system owner (policy L5).
- Reviewer: Controller (narrative L17) versus managers (policy L7).
- Removal timeframe: five business days (narrative L17) versus ten business days of the review (policy L7).
- NetSuite developer self-deployment: narrative L21 versus policy L9.

Coverage gaps against the modules:
- ClaimsLens has no described periodic access review.
- ClaimsLens has no described elevated-access provisioning.
- There is no described coverage of the AWS infrastructure/database layer or of the Okta administration layer.
- Cirrus Ops provides no SOC report (narrative L25), so reliance on the service organisation's controls needs a decision by the engagement team.
- Deprovisioning within one hour (narrative L11) is not a criterion for any attribute in the modules provided. It may matter to a termination procedure outside this digest.
- NetSuite went live on 1 October 2025 (narrative L7). The fiscal 2026 period dates are not stated, so whether a legacy system or data migration falls within the period needs confirmation.

Outside these modules, noted only: bank reconciliation, ClaimsLens snapshots with no restore testing, and the incident queue without priorities (all narrative L29); password and MFA requirements (policy L11).

This pass makes no effectiveness conclusion on any control.
